mechanism.claim: When completed one-minute realized variance is unusually large relative to nonoverlapping five-minute realized variance during an already volatile BTC day, the excess high-frequency variation identifies short-horizon reversal noise rather than persistent displacement; fade the completed four-hour return for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: short a strictly positive completed four-hour return and long a strictly negative return, only on a fresh joint signature-and-variation tail onset
mechanism.why_distinct: HVVSR compares identical-price realized variance at two fixed sampling frequencies. It is not a single-scale volatility level, jump/bipower statistic, OHLC range estimator, sign-count metric, volume/flow/OI/funding feature, fitted outcome, reused event set, prior repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both five-minute trailing realized variation and the one-minute/five-minute variance signature ratio must occupy causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse dual-tail multiscale sampling-frequency diagnostic at four-hour boundaries is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.one_minute_rv: sum squared one-minute close-to-previous-close log returns, excluding the unavailable return before the window
features.five_minute_rv: sum squared close-to-previous-close log returns of 288 exact nonoverlapping five-minute closes, excluding the unavailable return before the window
features.four_hour_return: log(last one-minute close / first one-minute open over [T-4h,T)), finite strict nonzero
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded
features.event: signature rank>=0.80 and variation rank>=0.65 now, while immediately prior source-valid decision was not jointly eligible
features.recursive_reset: all rolling windows, rank histories, and onset state reset after any invalid four-hour source block

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published variance-signature sampling-frequency diagnostic under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no sampling frequencies, window, formula, ranks, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Hansen and Lunde, Realized Variance and Market Microstructure Noise
external_basis.support: the volatility signature plot diagnoses sampling-frequency dependence and high-frequency microstructure contamination
external_basis.selection_use: fixed one-minute versus five-minute signature construction only; BTC direction, tails, onset, and holding application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
